scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @workspace/llama-website test && node --test scripts/check-public-game-copy.test.mjs && pnpm run test:paper && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server test && pnpm --filter @workspace/retro-arcade test
scripts.test:paper: env -u BSC_RPC_URL -u WALLET_ADDRESS -u WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY .pythonlibs/bin/python -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py'
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
